meta.batch: ARCHITECTURE BATCH 6 — Brand / Model / Series Architecture Foundation
meta.site: รับซื้อไอทีโคราช.com
meta.policy: Core Hub → Brand → Series → Model. W2 releases 30 Series and 20 exact Model pages under explicit manual approval; no location cross-product.

ownershipRules: BRAND must belong to one live category/family hub.
SERIES must belong to one live or approved BRAND/PLATFORM/FAMILY parent.
MODEL must belong to one SERIES unless a documented manufacturer taxonomy makes a direct FAMILY parent more accurate.
A candidate may have only one primary SEO owner.
Local area is a separate axis and must never be multiplied into Brand/Series/Model routes.
Condition/problem intent is a separate axis; only create a model-condition page when independent demand and unique content justify it.

modelPolicy.hardRule: Do not seed exact model pages in the foundation. Exact model identity must be verified before a MODEL candidate is added.

BRAND.demandEvidence: At least one first-party or search-demand evidence source; do not invent metrics.
minimumContentContract: condition/testing guidance relevant to the brand
local conversion path without duplicating the parent hub

SERIES.demandEvidence: Prefer GSC query→page, lead logs, transaction history, or inventory history.
minimumContentContract: examples of products/models in the series
seller questions unique to the series

MODEL.demandEvidence: Require concrete search or first-party business evidence before release.
prohibited: generic template with only model name swapped
automatic generation from a product catalog alone

prohibitedCrossProducts: MODEL×CONDITION at scale without independent demand
expansionAxesPolicy.reason: Prevent thin/doorway page multiplication and keep one clear query owner per intent.
